improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon, the Claude-powered assistant built for business owners and traders. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon is, its AI foundation, and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for a B2B audience of traders and business professionals. Including the price entry point and free searches addresses intent and reduces friction.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — the intelligent assistant that delivers instant answers for traders and business professionals. Try three free searches and see the difference."
improvements.rationale: The headline positions Gideon as a partnership rather than just a tool, building trust and conveying ongoing value. The subheading clearly communicates what Gideon does (instant AI answers), who it's for (traders and business professionals), and the low-barrier entry point (three free searches). This creates a clear value proposition without overpromising, encouraging trial conversion.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, and you can choose monthly or annual billing—with annual plans saving you 30 percent. Your membership unlocks voice chat, an unlimited workspace, and professional assistance whenever you need it.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the free trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition and reinforcing the low entry price and value (voice chat, unlimited workspace), it reduces uncertainty and encourages conversion at the paywall moment.
